part2.q: Who's in charge of ordering new office chairs?
opts: That would be Linda in facilities.
Please have a seat in the lobby.
part2.exp: Who 問誰負責訂椅子，答「設施部的 Linda」。「They're very comfortable」只是由椅子聯想；「have a seat」用 chair／seat 做相關字陷阱。

part2.q: When does the new parking policy take effect?
opts: At the start of next month.
Yes, the policy was updated recently by management.
In the garage behind the building.
part2.exp: When 問何時生效，答「下個月初」。疑問詞問句不能用 Yes；「In the garage…」答的是地點。

part2.q: Where can I find the updated price list?
opts: It's been posted on the shared drive.
I found it very useful, thanks.
part2.exp: Where 問哪裡找價目表，答「放在共用雲端硬碟」。「Prices have gone up」由 price 聯想；「I found it…」用 find／found 做同字陷阱。

part2.q: Why was the board meeting moved to the afternoon?
opts: In the boardroom on the tenth floor.
Thanks, I moved into a new apartment recently.
part2.exp: Why 問會議為何改到下午，答「幾位董事早上要搭飛機」。「In the boardroom…」答的是地點；「I moved into…」用 moved 做同字陷阱。

part2.q: How long will the system upgrade take?
opts: Yes, the upgrade is free for all current customers.
part2.exp: How long 問需要多久，答「恐怕要大半天」。「a very long hallway」用 long 做同字陷阱；疑問詞問句不能用 Yes。

part2.q: Which supplier did we choose for the packaging?
opts: We're still comparing the last two bids.
Please choose any seat you like.
part2.exp: Which 問選了哪家供應商，間接回答「還在比較最後兩家的報價」。「choose any seat」用 choose 做同字陷阱；「The boxes arrived damaged」只是由 packaging 聯想。

part2.q: What time does the client's train get in?
opts: Around four, if it's on schedule.
The training starts on Monday morning.
Please come in and have a seat.
part2.exp: What time 問火車幾點到，答「準點的話大約四點」。「training」和 train 是同字根陷阱；「come in」用 in 做同字陷阱。

part2.q: Has the marketing budget been approved yet?
opts: The finance team needs one more day.
It was a very successful marketing campaign last year.
part2.exp: 問預算核准了沒，答「財務部還需要一天」（＝還沒）。「successful marketing campaign」重複 marketing；「I haven't been there」答非所問。

part2.q: Are you going to the trade show in Frankfurt?
opts: Only if my travel request is approved.
Yes, I've traded in my old car.
part2.exp: 問是否去法蘭克福商展，答「出差申請核准才會去」。「The show starts at eight」答時間；「traded in」用 trade 做同字陷阱。

part2.q: Did you remember to lock the storage room?
opts: Marco was the last one to leave.
There's more room in the back.
part2.exp: 問有沒有鎖儲藏室，間接回答「Marco 是最後離開的人」（暗示由他負責）。「I don't remember his name」用 remember 做同字陷阱；「more room」用 room 做同字不同義陷阱。

part2.q: Isn't the cafeteria closed for renovations this week?
opts: I'd like a table near the window, please.
part2.exp: 否定問句確認餐廳是否在整修，答「其實昨天已經重新開放」。另外兩個只是由餐廳聯想，沒有回答問題。

part2.q: Shouldn't we print more copies of the agenda?
opts: The printer is next to the copier.
I agree with most of the items on it.
part2.exp: 否定問句建議多印議程，答「五十份應該夠了」（＝不用再印）。「The printer is next to the copier」由印刷聯想；「I agree with most of the items」由 agenda 聯想。

part2.q: You've already signed the lease, haven't you?
opts: The landlord is reviewing a few changes.
Please sign at the bottom of the form.
Yes, the sign is easy to see from the road.
part2.exp: 附加問句確認是否已簽租約，答「房東在看幾處修改」（＝還沒簽）。「sign at the bottom」用 sign 做同字陷阱；「the sign is easy to see」是同字不同義（招牌）。

part2.q: The conference room projector isn't working, is it?
opts: I'll ask IT to take a look.
It's a big project for our team.
No, I usually work from home on Fridays.
part2.exp: 附加問句確認投影機是不是壞了，回應「我請 IT 來看看」。「project」和 projector 音近；「work from home」用 work 做同字陷阱。

part2.q: Would you like the report printed or sent by e-mail?
opts: Yes, I'd like that very much.
The printer on the second floor.
part2.exp: 選擇疑問句，答「電子檔就好」＝選 e-mail。選擇疑問句通常不用 Yes 回答；「The printer…」答的是地點。

part2.q: Is the workshop on Tuesday or Wednesday?
opts: I'll work in the shop this weekend.
part2.exp: 選擇疑問句問週二或週三，答「已改到週四」，兩個都不是，是常見的正解型態。「Yes, every Tuesday」用 Yes 回答選擇題；「work in the shop」用 workshop 拆字做陷阱。

part2.q: I think the heater in the lobby is broken.
opts: Let's put in a repair request.
It's been broken into three groups.
part2.exp: 陳述句說大廳暖氣壞了，回應「我們提報修單吧」。「broken into three groups」是同字不同義（分成）；「The lobby opens at seven」重複 lobby。

part2.q: The client just canceled tomorrow's meeting.
opts: I'll meet you at the station.
Tomorrow is supposed to be sunny.
part2.exp: 陳述客戶取消會議，以問句回應「他們有說原因嗎？」。「meet you」用 meeting／meet 做同字根陷阱；「Tomorrow is supposed to be sunny」只重複 tomorrow。

part2.q: Could you help me set up the chairs for the seminar?
opts: Sure, how many rows do you need?
She's the chair of the committee.
part2.exp: 請求幫忙排椅子，答「好啊，要排幾排？」。「The seminar was very informative」時態不合；「chair of the committee」是同字不同義（主席）。

part2.q: Why don't we take a short break?
opts: Good idea, I could use some coffee.
It's a short walk from here.
part2.exp: Why don't we 是提議（休息一下吧），答「好主意，我正想喝杯咖啡」。「Because…」把提議誤當成問原因；「broken」和 break 是同字根陷阱；「a short walk」重複 short。

part2.q: How much does it cost to ship this package overseas?
opts: That depends on how much it weighs.
About two weeks by regular mail.
Yes, the ship leaves on Friday.
part2.exp: How much 問運費，答「要看重量」，是常見的間接回答。「About two weeks」答的是時間；「the ship leaves」是同字不同義（船）。

part2.q: Who's going to replace Ms. Ortiz while she's on leave?
opts: Her assistant will handle most of her accounts.
In place of the old one.
part2.exp: Who 問誰代理 Ortiz 女士的工作，答「她的助理會處理大部分客戶」。「She's leaving at five」把 on leave（休假）誤當成 leave（離開）；「In place of the old one」由 replace 聯想。

part2.q: Where should we hold the welcome reception?
opts: The garden would be nice if it doesn't rain.
Please hold the elevator for me.
part2.exp: Where 問迎新酒會辦在哪，答「不下雨的話花園不錯」。「hold the elevator」是同字不同義；「one hundred guests」答的是人數。

part2.q: Do you know when the inspection is scheduled?
opts: I'll check the calendar for you.
Yes, I know him very well.
The inspector found no problems at the factory last year.
part2.exp: 問檢查排在什麼時候，答「我幫你查一下行事曆」。「I know him very well」把 know 誤解成認識某人；「inspector found no problems」用 inspection／inspector 做同字根陷阱，而且時態不合。

part2.q: When are the new laptops being delivered?
opts: Didn't you get the e-mail from purchasing?
On the desk next to the window.
They're much lighter than the old ones we used.
part2.exp: When 問新筆電何時送到，以反問回應「你沒收到採購部的信嗎？」（暗示信裡有寫）。「On the desk…」答的是地點；「much lighter」只是由筆電聯想。

part34.title: 對話：牙醫診所改約

turns.t: Good morning, Bright Smile Dental. How can I help you?
Hi, this is Jason Park. I have a cleaning scheduled for Thursday at three, but something's come up at work. Could I move it to next week?
Let me see. Dr. Ellis has an opening next Tuesday at nine, or Wednesday at four thirty.
Wednesday afternoon would be better. I have a staff meeting every Tuesday morning.
All right, you're booked for Wednesday at four thirty. Since it's been more than a year since your last visit, please arrive ten minutes early to update your insurance information.

qs.q: Why is the man calling?
qs.exp: 男士說週四的洗牙因工作有事，想改到下週＝改約。

qs.q: Why does the man prefer Wednesday?
opts: He has a regular meeting on Tuesday
The clinic is closer to his home
He will be traveling on Thursday
Dr. Ellis works only on Wednesdays
qs.exp: 他說每週二早上都有員工會議（a staff meeting every Tuesday morning）＝週二有固定會議。

qs.q: What is the man asked to do?
opts: Arrive early to update some information
Fill out a patient form on the clinic's website
qs.exp: 女士請他提早十分鐘到，更新保險資料（arrive ten minutes early to update your insurance information）。

part34.title: 對話：原料漲價

turns.t: Hello, Ms. Grant. I'm calling from Oakfield Flour about your monthly order. I'm afraid our prices will be going up by eight percent from next month.
Eight percent? That's a big jump. We've been buying from you for over five years.
I understand. Wheat costs have risen sharply because of the poor harvest. But if you sign a twelve-month contract, we can keep the increase to five percent.
I'll need to discuss that with our owner first. Could you send me the contract terms in writing?
Of course. I'll e-mail them to you within the hour.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the call?
opts: To apologise for a late order
qs.exp: 男士說下個月起價格會漲 8%＝通知漲價。

qs.q: According to the man, what has caused the change?
qs.exp: 他說小麥成本大漲是因為收成不好（because of the poor harvest）。

qs.q: What does the woman ask for?
opts: A discount on her next order
A meeting with the man's manager
A sample of a new product
qs.exp: 她請男士把合約條件寫下來寄給她（send me the contract terms in writing）。

part34.title: 對話：搬到新樓層（三人對話）

turns.t: Hi, Raj, Tom. Thanks for meeting me. Our department moves up to the sixth floor next Friday, and I want to make sure everything's ready.
From the facilities side, the desks and cabinets will be delivered on Wednesday. We'll have everything assembled by Thursday afternoon.
And IT will set up the computers and phones on Thursday evening, after the furniture is in place.
Great. What do my staff need to do?
Just pack their personal items in the boxes we'll hand out on Monday, and label each box with their name and new desk number.
Also, remind them that the sixth floor uses a new access card. They can pick those up at reception.

qs.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
qs.exp: 整段在談部門下週五搬到六樓的準備＝辦公室搬遷。

qs.q: When will the computers be set up?
qs.exp: IT 的人說 Thursday evening（週四晚上）家具裝好後設定電腦和電話。週三是家具送來的日子。

qs.q: What should the staff pick up at reception?
qs.exp: 最後說六樓用新的門禁卡，可以到 reception（接待處）領取。箱子是週一發放。

part34.title: 對話：社群廣告預算（意圖題）

turns.t: Sophie, have you seen the results from last month's online advertising?
I have. The social media ads brought in three times as many visitors as the newspaper ads, for about half the cost.
So should we move more of the budget to social media for the summer campaign?
Well, our customers in the older age groups still mostly read the paper.
Fair enough. Maybe we keep one newspaper ad a week and put the rest online.
That sounds like a good balance. I'll draft a revised budget and send it to you tomorrow.

qs.q: What are the speakers discussing?
qs.exp: 他們在談上個月線上廣告的成效（results from last month's online advertising）。

qs.q: Why does the woman say, "our customers in the older age groups still mostly read the paper"?
opts: To suggest keeping some newspaper ads
To explain why the number of website visitors increased
qs.exp: 意圖題：男士想把更多預算移到社群廣告，女士提醒年長客群還是看報紙＝建議保留部分報紙廣告。男士接著提出每週保留一則報紙廣告。

qs.q: What will the woman do tomorrow?
qs.exp: 她說 I'll draft a revised budget and send it to you tomorrow（明天寄修改後的預算）。

part34.title: 對話：遺失行李

turns.t: Hi, my suitcase didn't come out at baggage claim. I was on the flight from Denver that landed an hour ago.
I'm sorry to hear that. May I see your baggage receipt? It's usually attached to your boarding pass.
Here it is. I really need it. I'm giving a presentation tomorrow morning, and my laptop charger and notes are inside.
Let me check. It looks like your bag was put on a later flight by mistake. It should arrive at nine tonight.
That's a relief. But I'm staying at a hotel downtown.
No problem. We'll deliver it to your hotel free of charge. Just write down the address on this form.

qs.q: Where most likely are the speakers?
qs.exp: 女士在 baggage claim（行李提領處）找不到行李，是剛降落的班機＝機場。

qs.q: Why is the woman worried?
opts: She needs some items for a presentation
She will miss a connecting flight
Her hotel reservation was canceled by mistake
qs.exp: 她說明天早上要簡報，筆電充電器和筆記都在行李箱裡。登機證還在她手上。

qs.q: What will the airline do?
opts: Deliver the bag to a hotel
Give the woman a new laptop charger
Put the woman on a later flight
qs.exp: 男士說會免費把行李送到她的飯店（deliver it to your hotel free of charge）。「later flight」是行李被誤放的班機，不是讓她改搭。

part34.title: 對話：新菜單試吃（三人對話）

turns.t: Thanks for staying after your shift, both of you. Chef wants your opinions on the three new dishes before we add them to the autumn menu.
The mushroom soup is lovely. I think customers will really like it.
I agree. But the lamb is quite spicy. Some of our regulars might find it too hot.
Good point. I'll ask Chef whether he can make a milder version, or at least mark it as spicy on the menu.
And the dessert portion seems small for the price.
I'll pass that on as well. We'll do a second tasting on Friday before the menu goes to the printer.

qs.q: Who most likely are the women?
qs.exp: 男士感謝她們下班後留下（staying after your shift）＝餐廳員工。regulars 是她們口中的熟客。

qs.q: What concern is mentioned about the lamb dish?
opts: It takes too long to prepare
qs.exp: 第二位女士說羊肉很辣（quite spicy），熟客可能覺得太辣。份量太小說的是甜點。

qs.q: What will happen on Friday?
opts: The new menu will be introduced
Chef will hire a new cook
qs.exp: 男士說週五會再試吃一次（a second tasting on Friday），之後菜單才送印。

part34.title: 對話：網站改版意見（意圖題）

turns.t: Mike, I just looked at the new design for our company website. It looks great overall.
Thanks. The designers worked hard on it. Did anything bother you?
Well, I tried to find our phone number, and it took me a couple of minutes.
Hmm, it's at the bottom of the contact page now. I guess that's not obvious.
Most of our customers still prefer to call us. Could we put it at the top of every page?
Sure. I'll ask the designers to add it to the header before we launch next week.

qs.q: What are the speakers discussing?
qs.exp: 女士剛看過公司網站的新設計（new design for our company website）＝網站改版。

qs.q: What does the woman imply when she says, "it took me a couple of minutes"?
opts: Some information is hard to find
The website loads too slowly on her computer
qs.exp: 意圖題：她找電話號碼花了好幾分鐘，暗示資訊不好找；男士也承認放在聯絡頁底部不明顯。不是網站載入慢。

qs.q: What will the man ask the designers to do?
opts: Add the phone number to the header
Change the colors used on the website's main page
qs.exp: 男士說會請設計師把電話加到頁首（add it to the header）。上線日期不變，仍是下週。

part34.title: 對話：開立公司帳戶

turns.t: Good afternoon. I've just started a small catering business, and I'd like to open a business account.
Congratulations. We have two options. The basic account is free, but you can only make twenty transactions a month.
I'll probably need more than that. I pay suppliers almost every day.
Then the business plus account would suit you better. It's eight pounds a month, with unlimited transactions and a free card reader for taking payments.
That sounds good. What do I need to open it?
Just your business registration certificate and a photo ID. If you have them with you, we can set it up today.

qs.q: What has the woman recently done?
qs.exp: 女士說她剛開了一家外燴公司（just started a small catering business）。

qs.q: Why does the woman need a business plus account?
qs.exp: 她說幾乎每天都要付款給供應商，二十筆不夠用＝交易次數多。基本帳戶才是免費的。

qs.q: What does the man say the woman needs to provide?
opts: A reference letter from her previous bank
qs.exp: 開戶需要營業登記證和附照片的身分證件（business registration certificate and a photo ID）。

part34.title: 對話：產品攝影

turns.t: Hi, Karen. The photographer for our new brochure is scheduled to come on Tuesday. Are the product samples ready?
Most of them. The blue water bottles still haven't arrived from the factory, though.
That's a problem. The blue bottle is supposed to be on the front cover.
I called the factory this morning. They said they'd ship them by express today, so they should be here Monday.
Okay. Let's also book the photographer for Wednesday, just in case they're late.
Good idea. I'll call her studio after lunch.

qs.q: What is the photographer going to do?
qs.exp: 攝影師是來拍新型錄（new brochure）用的照片。

qs.q: What problem does the woman mention?
opts: The brochure contains several printing errors
qs.exp: 藍色水壺樣品還沒從工廠送到（haven't arrived from the factory）。沒有提到損壞。

qs.q: What will the woman do after lunch?
qs.exp: 她說午餐後打電話給攝影師的工作室（call her studio），預約備用的週三。打給工廠是今天早上的事。

part34.title: 對話：研習課程額滿（意圖題）

turns.t: Hi, Daniel. I wanted to sign up for the project management course next month, but the website says it's full.
Yes, it filled up in two days. A lot of people want the certificate.
That's a shame. My manager wants me to lead the new warehouse project in the autumn.
Well, there's an online version of the same course, and it starts the week after.
Really? Does it give the same certificate?
It does. I'll send you the link to the registration page.

qs.q: What does the woman want to do?
qs.exp: 她想報名下個月的專案管理課程（sign up for the project management course）。

qs.q: Why does the woman say, "My manager wants me to lead the new warehouse project in the autumn"?
opts: To explain why the course is important to her
To ask for a change to the course schedule next month
qs.exp: 意圖題：課程額滿，她說主管要她秋天帶新倉庫專案，表示這門課對她很重要、需要上。男士接著提供線上版的替代方案。

qs.q: What will the man send the woman?
qs.exp: 他說會寄報名頁的連結給她（send you the link to the registration page）。

part34.title: 對話：停車費率（圖表題）

turns.t: Excuse me, I'm here for a job interview in the Harmon Building. How much is parking?
It depends on how long you stay. How long do you expect to be here?
The interview is about an hour, but then they want me to take a skills test, so maybe two and a half hours in total.
Okay. Just keep your ticket with you, because you'll need it to get out of the garage.
Will do. Do I pay here when I leave?
No, there's a payment machine by the elevators. It takes cards and cash.

qs.q: Why is the man visiting the building?
qs.exp: 男士說他來 Harmon 大樓參加面試（a job interview）。

qs.q: Look at the graphic. How much will the man most likely pay?
qs.exp: 圖表題：面試約一小時，但之後還有技能測驗，總共大約兩個半小時，屬於 2–3 小時的 $12。只看面試一小時會誤選 $5 或 $8。

qs.q: Where should the man pay for parking?
opts: At a machine near the elevators
qs.exp: 女士說電梯旁有繳費機（a payment machine by the elevators）。

part34.graphic:
HARMON BUILDING PARKING
Up to 1 hour ...... $5
1 to 2 hours ...... $8
2 to 3 hours ...... $12
Over 3 hours ...... $15

part34.title: 對話：配送方式（圖表題）

turns.t: Hello, I'd like to send these product samples to a client in Manchester.
Certainly. When do they need to arrive?
The client is presenting them to her board on Thursday morning, so they need to be there by Wednesday.
Today's Monday, so standard delivery won't make it. You'd need one of the faster options.
Then I'll take the cheapest one that gets there in time. Oh, and can I get a tracking number?
Yes, all of our services include tracking. I'll print the label for you now.

qs.q: What is the woman sending?
qs.exp: 她要寄產品樣品（product samples）給曼徹斯特的客戶。

qs.q: Look at the graphic. Which service will the woman choose?
qs.exp: 圖表題：今天週一，週三前要到，要兩個工作天內。Standard 要四天來不及；能及時送到的選項裡最便宜的是 Express（兩天，£9）。Next Day 和 Same Day 比較貴。

qs.q: What does the woman ask about?
qs.exp: 她問能不能拿到追蹤號碼（a tracking number）。

part34.graphic:
DELIVERY OPTIONS
Service ..... Days .. Price
Standard .... 4 ..... £5
Express ..... 2 ..... £9
Next Day .... 1 ..... £14
Same Day .... 0 ..... £25

part34.title: 對話：戶外活動天氣（圖表題）

turns.t: Greg, we need to pick a day next week for the company picnic. Have you checked the forecast?
I have. Monday and Thursday look rainy, so those are out.
What about Wednesday? It's supposed to be sunny.
It is, but the park is closed that day for tree maintenance.
Then it'll have to be the other day. It might be a bit cloudy, but at least it'll be dry.
I'll send out the invitation this afternoon. And I'll order the food from that barbecue place everyone liked last year.

qs.q: What are the speakers planning?
qs.exp: 女士說要為公司野餐（company picnic）選日期。

qs.q: Look at the graphic. Which day will the event most likely be held?
qs.exp: 圖表題：週一、週四會下雨；週三晴天但公園關閉；剩下多雲但不下雨的那天。預報表上多雲的是 Tuesday。

qs.q: What does the man say he will do?
qs.exp: 他說會向去年大家喜歡的燒烤店訂餐（order the food from that barbecue place）。

part34.title: 短講：圖書館開放時間調整

turns.t: Good afternoon, and thank you for visiting the Westbrook Public Library. Please note that from the first of next month, the library will open at ten in the morning instead of nine on weekdays, but we'll stay open until eight in the evening, two hours later than now. These new hours are based on feedback from our members, many of whom told us they can only visit after work. Our study rooms can still be booked up to a week in advance at the information desk. And don't forget that our children's reading club meets every Saturday at eleven.

qs.q: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
opts: To explain a change in opening hours
To announce that the library will close for repairs
qs.exp: 廣播說下個月起平日開館時間改成十點、閉館延到八點＝說明開放時間調整。

qs.q: Why is the library making the change?
opts: Fewer people visit in the morning
qs.exp: 改變是根據會員回饋，很多人只能下班後來（can only visit after work）。

qs.q: What can listeners do at the information desk?
opts: Sign up for the reading club
qs.exp: 自修室可以在服務台提前一週預約（booked … at the information desk）。讀書會只說每週六十一點聚會。

part34.title: 短講：超市店內廣播（意圖題）

turns.t: Attention, Fresh Basket shoppers. Today only, all fruit and vegetables in our produce section are twenty percent off. That includes our locally grown strawberries, which just came in this morning. Now, I should mention that we only received forty boxes. If you'd like to try our new prepared meals, free samples are available near the bakery until two o'clock. And as always, members of our Fresh Rewards program earn double points on every purchase made before noon.

qs.q: What is being offered today?
qs.exp: 今天蔬果區全部打八折（twenty percent off）。

qs.q: Why does the speaker say, "we only received forty boxes"?
opts: To encourage listeners to buy soon
To explain why strawberry prices have gone up this week
To ask for help from staff
qs.exp: 意圖題：他先說草莓今天早上才到，接著說只到了四十箱，暗示數量有限、要買要快。

qs.q: How can listeners earn double points?
qs.exp: Fresh Rewards 會員在中午前消費可以拿雙倍點數（before noon）。

part34.title: 短講：交通路況廣播

turns.t: This is Radio Clearwater with your morning traffic update. Drivers heading into the city centre on the A40 should expect delays of around twenty minutes, due to a broken-down lorry near the Hillside exit. Recovery crews are on the way, and the road should be clear by nine. Meanwhile, the Northgate Bridge remains closed for repair work until Friday, so please use the Riverside Road instead. And if you're taking the train, services on the Eastern Line are running normally this morning. Our next update is at half past eight, right after the news.

qs.q: What is causing delays on the A40?
opts: A vehicle that has broken down
qs.exp: A40 延誤是因為 Hillside 出口附近有一輛故障的貨車（a broken-down lorry）。修橋是 Northgate Bridge 的事。

qs.q: What are drivers advised to do?
qs.exp: Northgate Bridge 封閉，請改走 Riverside Road（use the Riverside Road instead）＝改道。

qs.q: When is the next traffic update?
qs.exp: 下一次路況是 half past eight（八點半），在新聞之後。九點是道路預計排除的時間。

part34.title: 短講：新進員工說明會

turns.t: Welcome, everyone, to your first day at Pinewood Insurance. My name is Carol, and I work in human resources. This morning, you'll get your employee badges and set up your computer accounts. After lunch, which is provided in the cafeteria on the second floor, you'll meet your team leaders, who will show you around your departments. Each of you will also be paired with an experienced colleague who will answer your questions during your first month. Before we begin, please make sure you've signed the confidentiality form in your welcome folder and handed it to me.

qs.q: Who most likely are the listeners?
qs.exp: 歡迎大家第一天到職（your first day at Pinewood Insurance）＝新進員工。

qs.q: What will listeners do after lunch?
qs.exp: 午餐後會和組長見面（meet your team leaders）。帳號和識別證是早上的事。

qs.q: What does the speaker ask listeners to do?
qs.exp: 請大家簽好保密表格交給她（signed the confidentiality form … handed it to me）。同事是公司配對的，不是自己選。

part34.title: 短講：員工旅遊船遊語音留言（意圖題）

turns.t: Hi, Mr. Haddad. This is Emma from Bayview Boat Tours calling about your company's harbour cruise this Saturday. I'm afraid the weather service has issued a strong wind warning for Saturday afternoon. Our captain says the boat can still go out, but it'll be quite a rough ride. Several of your guests are bringing small children. We can move your booking to Sunday at no extra cost, and the forecast for Sunday is clear. Please let me know by Thursday evening, as Sunday bookings are filling up quickly.

qs.q: Why is the speaker calling?
opts: To discuss a possible schedule change
To advertise a new evening tour of the harbour
qs.exp: 她說週六下午有強風特報，可以改到週日＝討論是否改期。

qs.q: Why does the speaker say, "Several of your guests are bringing small children"?
opts: To suggest the trip may be rough for them
To ask for the children's ages
To offer a discount for children under twelve years old
To explain why the boat is full
qs.exp: 意圖題：船長說還是能出航，但會很顛簸，接著提到有不少小孩同行，暗示對他們會不舒服，所以建議改到週日。

qs.q: What does the speaker ask the listener to do by Thursday?
qs.exp: 請他週四晚上前告訴她（let me know by Thursday evening）是否改期。

part34.title: 短講：家電量販店週年慶廣告

turns.t: It's Tech Town's tenth anniversary, and we're celebrating with our biggest sale ever. This weekend only, save up to forty percent on laptops, tablets, and home appliances. Spend more than five hundred dollars, and we'll give you a free pair of wireless headphones. Need help setting up your new devices? Our experts will install and connect everything in your home for just twenty-nine dollars. Visit any of our twelve locations, or shop online at techtown.com. But hurry, because these deals end Sunday at six p.m.

qs.q: What is the store celebrating?
qs.exp: Tech Town 十週年（tenth anniversary）。

qs.q: What will customers receive if they spend over $500?
qs.exp: 消費超過五百美元送無線耳機（a free pair of wireless headphones）。安裝服務要付二十九美元。

qs.q: When does the sale end?
opts: At the end of the month
qs.exp: 優惠到週日下午六點結束（end Sunday at six p.m.）。

part34.title: 短講：工廠擴建新聞

turns.t: In business news, Carver Motors announced today that it will expand its parts factory in Milton, creating about three hundred new jobs over the next two years. The company says the expansion is needed to keep up with growing demand for its electric vehicles. Construction of the new building is expected to begin early next year. Local officials welcomed the news, saying it will help the town's economy. Carver Motors will hold a job fair at the Milton Community College next month for people interested in applying.

qs.q: What is the news report mainly about?
qs.exp: Carver Motors 宣布擴建 Milton 零件廠＝工廠擴建。

qs.q: According to the report, why is the company expanding?
opts: Demand for its products is increasing
The town offered the company special tax benefits
qs.exp: 公司說擴建是為了跟上電動車日益增加的需求（growing demand）。

qs.q: What will take place next month?
qs.exp: 下個月在社區大學舉辦徵才博覽會（a job fair）。動工是明年初。

part34.title: 短講：業務會議（意圖題）

turns.t: Right, let's look at the sales figures for the third quarter. Overall, sales were up six percent, mainly thanks to strong demand in the south. The north was flat again, and I know some of you have been working very hard up there. Now, the north has had three new competitors open in the past year. So we're going to try something different. From next month, we'll offer free delivery on all orders in the northern region. I'd like each northern sales rep to send me a list of their top ten customers by Friday, so we can contact them about the offer first.

qs.q: What does the speaker say about third-quarter sales?
opts: They were the lowest of the year
They were the same in every region
qs.exp: 整體銷售成長 6%（up six percent）。北區持平，所以不是每區都一樣。

qs.q: Why does the speaker say, "the north has had three new competitors open in the past year"?
opts: To explain why sales there have not grown
To praise the northern team for their hard work this year
qs.exp: 意圖題：他先說北區又是持平，接著提到一年內開了三家競爭對手，說明北區業績沒有成長的原因，然後提出新做法。

qs.q: What are some listeners asked to send?
qs.exp: 北區業務代表要在週五前寄前十大客戶名單（a list of their top ten customers）。

part34.title: 短講：大樓回收時間表（圖表題）

turns.t: Good morning, everyone. This is a message from building management about recycling. Because of a change in the city's collection schedule, the bins for paper and cardboard will now be collected on Thursdays instead of Mondays. All other days stay the same. Please remember to flatten cardboard boxes before putting them in the bin, as they take up far less space. Also, the bin for electronic waste in the car park has been removed. Old phones and batteries can now be left at the security office on the ground floor.

qs.q: Why has the schedule changed?
opts: The city changed its collection days
qs.exp: 因為市政府的收運時間改了（a change in the city's collection schedule）。

qs.q: Look at the graphic. Which day will now have two types of collection?
qs.exp: 圖表題：紙類和紙箱從週一改到週四，其他不變。表上週四原本收塑膠，所以改完後週四會收兩種。

qs.q: Where should old batteries be taken?
qs.exp: 電子廢棄物回收桶已撤掉，舊手機和電池改放到一樓保全室（the security office）。

part34.title: 短講：各區銷售報告（圖表題）

turns.t: Thanks for joining today's call. Before we get into next year's plans, let's review this year's results by region. As you can see on the chart, our strongest region was once again the West. But I want to highlight the team that improved the most. Their sales were the second lowest last year, and this year they moved into second place. That team is going to share what worked for them in a short presentation after the break. Then we'll talk about the budget for next year's marketing.

qs.q: What is the purpose of the call?
opts: To review results and plan for next year
To introduce a new sales director
To announce a change in products
To discuss customer complaints about late deliveries
qs.exp: 他說先回顧今年各區業績，再談明年計畫和行銷預算。

qs.q: Look at the graphic. Which team will give a presentation?
qs.exp: 圖表題：進步最多的團隊今年排第二。表上 West 第一（$8.2M），第二是 South（$6.5M），所以 South 會報告。

qs.q: What will be discussed after the presentation?
qs.exp: 報告後會討論明年行銷的預算（the budget for next year's marketing）。
